name: Declan O'Malley
bio:
Declan's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not on the track, but in the stands, captivated by the roar of the engines at Mondello Park. After earning his degree in Human Resources, he initially worked for a tech startup, honing his recruitment and team-building skills. However, the lure of motorsport was too strong, and he actively sought a role within the industry, seeing it as a unique challenge to build high-performing teams in a high-pressure environment.

At Racing Bulls, Declan is known for his meticulous approach to talent acquisition and development. He believes in fostering a supportive and inclusive team environment where everyone can thrive. He's particularly passionate about identifying and nurturing young talent, ensuring the team has a pipeline of skilled professionals for the future. His dedication to finding the right fit for each role has earned him the respect of both management and staff.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Declan is of average height with a warm, approachable demeanor.

quirks: Always has a packet of Irish breakfast tea on his desk.
Organizes team-building activities with a motorsport theme, like go-karting or pit stop challenges.
Unintentionally quotes famous motorsport figures when discussing HR policies.
